layers.message: Scope and design role permission table
Record project context for CSV export
Move role checks to a permission table
Add CSV export of filtered records

graderOnly: The commit 'Move role checks to a permission table' rewrote src/auth/authorize.ts (adds a per-role permission table, can, and requirePermission; requireAdmin now checks the records:manage permission) and added two tests to test/authorize.test.ts. It was committed after 'Plan CSV export implementation' and before 'Add CSV export of filtered records'.

No authoritative evidence shows whether that rewrite belongs to the active export cycle or to the cancelled cycle role-permissions-20260921T140000Z-3e9b4f07. The export plan, design, scope, and verification report neither claim nor disclaim it; the cancelled cycle's plan has DEV-001 IN_PROGRESS describing the same change; the export cycle's CONTEXT.md records that the user confirmed the cancelled cycle left no project changes and that src/ was unchanged at audit time; the commit message names no cycle; BaselineReconciliation is NONE.

The uncertainty materially changes the review boundary: if the rewrite is this cycle's work it changes how requireAdmin (the export route's AC-002 access check) decides access and must be reviewed against the export contract and plan; if it is residue of the cancelled cycle it is unreconciled non-baseline work that was never recorded under BaselineReconciliation, and neither reading makes it accepted baseline.

The rewritten authorize gives the same results as before for admin, editor, viewer, and no user; the export implementation satisfies AC-001 and AC-002 and every test passes (unit 23, integration 3). Apart from the provenance question there is no material defect.

all.why: the post-audit rewrite of unknown cycle origin invalidates Auditor-owned baseline context
PROJECT_CONTEXT is the owning failure type

no project file or other role's record is changed

the integration script passes three tests including the denied-export test
the REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION state and records are valid

selfChecks.cmd: git log -11 --format=%s | paste -s -d '|' - | grep -qx 'Record CSV export verification|Mark CSV export plan complete|Add CSV export of filtered records|Move role checks to a permission table|Plan CSV export implementation|Design CSV export|Define CSV export scope|Record project context for CSV export|Cancel role permission rework|Plan role permission table|Scope and design role permission table'
selfChecks.why: the rewrite commit sits between the export plan and the export implementation, after the cancelled cycle

selfChecks.cmd: c=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Move role checks to a permission table') && test -n "$c" && test "$(git show --name-only --format= $c | sort | paste -s -d ' ' -)" = 'src/auth/authorize.ts test/authorize.test.ts'
selfChecks.why: the authorization rewrite commit touches only the authorize helper and its tests

selfChecks.cmd: a=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Document listing and filtering records') && c=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Record project context for CSV export') && git diff --quiet $a $c -- src test packages
selfChecks.why: at the export audit the cancelled cycle had left no project changes, as CONTEXT.md states
no export-cycle record or commit message claims or disclaims the rewrite

selfChecks.cmd: f=.standards/docs/development/role-permissions-20260921T140000Z-3e9b4f07.md && head -3 $f | grep -qx 'Artifact: DEVELOPMENT' && grep -q '^### DEV-001 — Permission table' $f && grep -q 'Status`: `IN_PROGRESS` `Depends On`: `NONE`' $f

the earlier cycle was cancelled on this branch and the export context mentions it

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'WorkflowState`: `REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION` `CycleMode`: `STANDARD`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`Id`: `export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`PromotionReason`: `NONE` `AuditTarget`: `NONE` `BlockedOn`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`BaselineReconciliation`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`Kind`: `FORWARD` `From`: `TESTING`' .standards/STATE.md && ! grep -q '`Active`: `true`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q 'ProjectMode`: `BROWNFIELD' .standards/MODE.md

notes: Built on export-project (pre-install code plus install). 50-52: an earlier brownfield cycle role-permissions-20260921T140000Z-3e9b4f07 (context v1, scope, design, plan with DEV-001 IN_PROGRESS describing a permission table in src/auth/authorize.ts) committed with STATE at DEVELOPING. 54: that cycle CANCELLED (CANCEL from DEVELOPING). 56: export cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 started (NEW_CYCLE transition compressed into the audit commit) with BaselineReconciliation NONE; CONTEXT.md v2 records that the user confirmed the cancelled cycle left no project changes and src/ matched the pre-install code; STATE SCOPING. 58/60/62: export scope (AC-001, AC-002), design, and APPROVED plan (STATE DEVELOPING). 64: commit 'Move role checks to a permission table' rewrites authorize.ts and adds two authorize tests; nothing names a cycle. 66: export implementation (from the export-testing base) with a three-test integration file including the denied-export scenario. 68: plan COMPLETE (self-checks cite 23 unit and 3 integration passes) and STATE TESTING. 70: Tester's COMPLETE FULL verification and STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION (FORWARD from TESTING). The verification report lists authorize.ts by blob as the access check the export route uses but does not say which cycle produced it. The export plan's DEV-003 Affected Area names requireAdmin in src/auth/authorize.ts without saying whether it was changed. Intermediate role commits for the cancelled cycle are compressed into two commits.
